dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible perimeters of the three most prominent dorsal structures are roughly elliptical 'O' shapes with sharp light-to-dark intensity gradients from the outer boundary to the center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily located in the interstitial regions between macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most distinct macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral with the longest diagonal oriented along the dorsal-ventral axis.
